title: GappleCraft 2.0
description: Gapplecraft adds a recipe for the enchanted apples, and it also adds jade support for Simple Apple Tree from Curseforge, this mod is a fork for that mod.
body:
GappleCraft
craftable enchanted apples
GappleCraft is an addon for Simple Apple Tree that expands apple farming with a Blaze Powder infusion system, Jade integration, and a balanced Enchanted Golden Apple recipe.

This mod does not modify or include any code from Simple Apple Tree. It works through compatibility, preserving the original experience while adding new gameplay features.

How It Works
Using Blaze Powder on any apple leaf will infuse the entire tree.

Affects the whole tree
Lasts for 3 harvest cycles
Each cycle consumes one charge
After the third cycle, the tree returns to normal
While infused, trees have improved drops:

Increased chance for Golden Apples
Increased chance for Enchanted Golden Apples
Visual and sound feedback during boosted harvests
Jade Integration
GappleCraft connects Simple Apple Tree with Jade to display:

Growth percentage and stage
Maturity status
Blaze infusion status
Remaining boosted harvests
Jade is optional but recommended.

Enchanted Golden Apple Recipe
GappleCraft adds a balanced crafting recipe:

Top:

Lapis Lazuli, Blaze Powder, Lapis Lazuli
Middle:

Glowstone Dust, Golden Apple, Glowstone Dust
Bottom:

Glowstone Dust, Glowstone Dust, Glowstone Dust
Output:

3 Enchanted Golden Apples
Fully compatible with JEI.

Requirements
Forge 1.20.1
Simple Apple Tree (required)
Jade (optional)
Disclaimer
GappleCraft is an independent addon and is not affiliated with the Simple Apple Tree team.

This mod does not include or modify any code from Simple Apple Tree. It was created as a passion project.

Full credit goes to the creator of Simple Apple Tree for their work.
